sources.label: Official ASICS Size Charts and Fit Guides, Men > Clothing, Men's Tops Size Guide (chest/waist/hips ranges)

audit: Old /gb/en-gb/size-guide/ 404s; guide is /customer-service/size-fit-guide/ (Men > Clothing). Men's Tops chart prints chest/waist/hips ranges for S-3XL with 'How to measure' body instructions; no unit is printed (values are cm by magnitude). S 88/73 -> 88-96/75-83; M 93/78 -> 96-104/83-91; XL 105/90 -> 113-124/100-111; XXL 112/97 -> 2XL 124-136/111-123. XS removed (not printed); hips and 3XL added; UK/US/EU removed (not printed).
